Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, October 8 · NFL Week 5 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 8, 7:53 PM ET

Dak Prescott has the highest SPAGS projection in the Buccaneers at Cowboys DraftKings Showdown: 20.9 points at $10,400 FLEX, 31.4 at captain for $15,600. Across 100,000 simulations Prescott holds 71% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Prescott is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 8.0 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary, in a game with a 49.5-point total.

Jalon Daniels has the largest captain share: 17.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Daniels at captain. The model has him running 5.9 times. Dak Prescott is the next captain in line, at 17.3%.

Dallas is a 9.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 29.5 for the Cowboys and 20 for the Buccaneers.

Behind Prescott and Daniels, the next projections are CeeDee Lamb (19.9, $11,800), Javonte Williams (18.0, $10,800) and George Pickens (14.6, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 8, 7:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jalon Daniels, TB QB ($8,600 FLEX / $12,900 CPT)

Jalon Daniels holds 17.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $12,900 and the 19.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.9 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Daniels averaged 19.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 34.4. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.8% as the captain and 51.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Dak Prescott, DAL QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Dak Prescott holds 17.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 20.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Prescott averaged 20.9 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 38.3. He holds 71% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.3% as the captain and 54.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

CeeDee Lamb holds 13.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 19.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 32.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Lamb averaged 19.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 39.3. He holds 55% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.6% as the captain and 41.9% in a FLEX spot.

Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown?

Jalon Daniels holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 17.8%, ahead of Dak Prescott (17.3%) and CeeDee Lamb (13.6%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Buccaneers vs Cowboys?

Build around Cade Otton at captain with Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb and Jalon Daniels at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (209 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $12,600 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown?

Dak Prescott leads the SPAGS model at 20.9 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 31.4 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Buccaneers vs Cowboys Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Brevyn Spann-Ford (4.4 points at $1,600), Ryan Flournoy (9.0 points at $3,800) and Cade Otton (9.3 points at $4,400).

What is the Buccaneers vs Cowboys spread and total?

The Cowboys are a 9.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 49.5, with implied team totals of 29.5 for the Cowboys and 20 for the Buccaneers.
